text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: GPU prefill OOM spike on gpu-node-23 causing container restarts. Incident INC-2026-319. Paging oncall.

alex (oncall): I'm on. Seeing ~30 container restarts over the last 5m tied to the prefill path (long_session). Investigating hotpool.

sri (ml-runtime): Looking at runtime logs — KV cache allocation blows up when multiple long prompts run concurrently. Sample: 
```
2026-03-17T01:31:23Z ERROR runtime: kvcache_alloc failed: OOM (requested 1.2GiB)
runtime/serving: prefilling tokens for session=abcd1234 length=16384
stack trace: goroutine 412 [running]:
...
```

jamie (sre): Proposal: cordon gpu-node-23 to stop new pods, scale down hotpool replicas, and apply runtime config guardrails. Any immediate customer impact?

megan (support): Yes — a single large customer reported ~1% requests returning 5xx around 01:30 UTC (errors on prefill). Most requests retried successfully. CS engaged and drafting a customer summary.

alex (oncall): Ok. I'll cordon the node and start a fast rollback/guard.

sri (ml-runtime): Quick mitigations I can push now: set PREFILL_MAX_LEN=1024 for the hotpool, enable kvcache_trim=true, and disable speculative prefill for long_session route. These are runtime flags; rolling to a subset first.

jamie (sre): Executing ops: `kubectl cordon gpu-node-23` then scale hotpool down 12->6 replicas. Tainting node so scheduler avoids it.

alex (oncall): Running commands now: 
```
kubectl cordon gpu-node-23
kubectl scale deployment hotpool -n runtime --replicas=6
kubectl set env ds/runtime PREFILL_MAX_LEN=1024 -n runtime
```

incident-bot: mitigation started at 1734567975 (automated note).

nick (infra): I see concurrent CUDA errors too (`cudaErrorIllegalAddress`) around the same window — collecting kernel logs and coredumps. Could be memory corruption exacerbated by the allocation surge.

sri (ml-runtime): Good catch. Add validation: trim KV cache allocations if prefill length > 2048. Also create a synthetic regression: 100 concurrent 16k-token prefill sessions to repro.

megan (support): Customer update: draft message ready — "We've applied throttles to very long requests and rolled configuration mitigations. Services restored for the affected pool; we're investigating root cause and will follow up." Want sign-off before sending.

ajamie (sre): Metrics: prefill OOMs down to single digits, container restarts stopped after cordon/scale. Error rate for long_session route down from ~1.2% -> 0.18%.

alex (oncall): Action items: 1) Keep node-23 tainted/offline until infra finishes driver/kernel checks; 2) Roll PREFILL_MAX_LEN=1024 across remaining hotpools if stable; 3) Add regression test and load-shedding rule for concurrent long prompts; 4) Postmortem owner: sri.

sri (ml-runtime): I'll own postmortem. Will also prepare a runtime patch that enforces kvcache hard limits per-session.

alex (oncall): Handing off to night oncall @jamie in 20m. Current state: mitigations applied, node cordoned, customer notified (draft). Monitoring for 30m.

jamie (sre): :thumbsup: will take over. Noting to follow up with infra for coredump analysis and with support for final customer comms.

megan (support): I'll send the customer draft once you all 👍.

incident-bot: incident status -> mitigated (partial). Follow-up: postmortem required.

alex (oncall): Closing bridge, handing over in channel. Will add the timeline and attach logs to the postmortem ticket.

jamie (sre): Copy. Monitoring dashboards ready.

(megan and sri reacted :eyes:)
